prose.description: Humans with dark skin and pale hair, common in the hot south and on the roads of the Border Zone. They are known for a stubborn independence, and many become drifters, mercenaries, or Tech Hunters rather than serve a lord. The Holy Nation accepts them as human but watches them closely.
prose.speech: Plain and honest, sometimes past the point of tact. They dislike being told what to do and say so.
